content.text: Proje yapısını inceleyerek eksiklikleri tespit edelim.<tool_call>ls: .<tool_call>bash: ls -la apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/<tool_call>bash: ls -la apps/desktop/src/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no src dir"<tool_call>bash: ls -la frontend/src/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no frontend src"<tool_call>bash: ls -la src/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no root src"

Proje yapısını daha derin inceleyelim.<tool_call>bash: find apps/desktop/src-tauri/src -type f -name "*.rs" 2>/dev/null | head -20<tool_call>bash: find frontend/src -type f \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.jsx" \) 2>/dev/null | head -20<tool_call>bash: find src -type f \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.jsx" -o -name "*.rs" \) 2>/dev/null | head -20<tool_call>read: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs<tool_call>read: apps/desktop/package.json<tool_call>read: frontend/package.json<tool_call>read: package.json 2>/dev/null || echo "no root package.json"<tool_call>read: tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null || echo "no root tsconfig.json"<tool_call>read: README.md 2>/dev/null | head -50 || echo "no README"
